set.body: Create deterministic synthetic and representative real corpora covering graph size, density, label entropy, WL depth, OA multiplicity, query novelty, shortest-path structure, and sparse-to-dense feature regimes. Record exact semantic configurations for Grakern, GraKeL, GraphKernels.jl, and any later comparator; every admitted row carries an independent semantic checksum or tolerance contract.
set.title: Build admitted graph-kernel workload and comparator corpus
